CITY OF ALHAMBRA PLANNING COMMISSION
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  September 19, 2022

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER:  7:00 P.M. via video conference and teleconference.

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Ho, Juarez, Mojarro, Olson, Pham, Sahu, Tsujii, Wang, Garcia, Gardea

  Absent:  None

  Staff Present: Vanessa Reynoso, Deputy Director; Paul Lam, Principal Planner; Maia
  McCurley, Senior Planner; Megan Wu, Associate Planner; Kassandra
  Cornejo, Assistant Planner; Jessica Vargas, Planning Technician; Erica
  Vega, Deputy City Attorney

C.  FLAG SALUTE:  Led by President Gardea

D.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  •  There were no Consent Agenda items.

E.  RE-ORDER THE AGENDA:

  MOTION:

  Items 1, 2, and 3, and to move Agenda Item 1 after Agenda Items 4, 2,

  Roll Call Vote: 9-0-1-0

 F.  PUBLIC HEARINGS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 4:  GENERAL PLAN AMENDMENT AMD-22-01, ZONE CHANGE AMD-22-02
  AND LOT LINE ADJUSTMENT LOTA-22-01 (7:05 P.M.)
  • Story Park (APN: 5337-002-900), 301 North Story Place, 305
  North Story Place, 311 North Story Place, 317 North Story Place,
  323 North Story Place, 327 North Story Place
  • Request: This is an application for a Lot Line Adjustment, General
  Plan Amendment, and Zone Change to transfer approximately 0.29
  acres of land from Story Park to the six abutting residential properties
  to the east. The transfer will necessitate a General Plan Amendment
  to change the land use designation of the transferred land from Open
  Space to Low Density Residential and a Zone Change to change the
  Zoning classification from Open Space to R-1 (Single Family
  Residential). Pursuant to the California Environmental Quality Act, an
  Initial Study and Negative Declaration have been prepared for the
  proposal.
  • Recommended  Action:  Adopt  Resolution  No.  22-30,
  recommending that the City Council approve General Plan
  Amendment AMD-22-01, Zone Change AMD-22-02, and Lot Line
  Adjustment LOTA-22-01 to transfer approximately 0.29 acres of
  public park land located in Story Park to six abutting private
  residential properties to the east, change the General Plan land use
  designation of the transferred land from Open Space to Low Density
  Residential and change the zoning classification of the transferred
  land from OS (Open Space) to R-1 (Single Family Residential).
  • Commissioner Sahu recused himself from the item.
  • Principal Planner Paul Lam provided the Staff presentation.
  • The public hearing was opened and then closed.
  • Public Comments:
  1.) Jennifer Ng
  2.) Bert Ng
  3.) Ron Sahu
  4.) Suhail Khalil
  5.) Lewis McCammon

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to reopen Public Comment.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Mojarro, Seconded by Commissioner Wang.
  •  The motion carried by the following majority vote:

  Majority Vote: 9-0-1-0
  Ayes:  Ho, Juarez, Mojarro, Olson, Pham, Tsujii, Wang, Garcia,
  Gardea
  Noes:  None
  Recused: Sahu
  Absent:  None

  •  The public hearing was opened and then closed.
  •  Public Comments:
  1.) Ron Sahu
  2
  09/19/2022
 MOTION:
  •  Moved to adopt Resolution No. 22-30, recommending that the City
  Council approve General Plan Amendment AMD-22-01, Zone Change
  AMD-22-02, and Lot Line Adjustment LOTA-22-01 to transfer
  approximately 0.29 acres of public park land located in Story Park to six
  abutting private residential properties to the east, change the General

  transferred land from OS (Open Space) to R-1 (Single Family

  •  Moved by Commissioner Olson, Seconded by Vice President Garcia.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 9-0-1-0

  Absent:  None

AGENDA
ITEM 2:  REVISION TO CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT CU-16-15 (7:46 P.M.)
  • 1508 South Marengo Avenue
  • Request: This is an application for a Revision to Conditional Use
  Permit CU-16-15 to establish an administrative use within an 11,286
  square foot building that is under construction. The administrative
  use is provided to support a existing skilled nursing facility located on
  a site of approximately 69,261 square feet (1.5) acres) located in the
  R-3 (High Density Residential) zone. (This application is exempt from
  the California Environmental Quality Act.)
  • Recommended Action: Continue the public hearing to a future date.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to continue the item to a date uncertain.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Sahu, Seconded by Commissioner Wang.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 10-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Ho, Juarez, Mojarro, Olson, Pham, Sahu, Tsujii, Wang,
  Garcia, Gardea
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

AGENDA
ITEM 3:  PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT PD-21-32, CONDITIONAL USE
  PERMIT CUP-20-09 AND VARIANCE VAR-21-12 (7:48 P.M.)
  • 1041 South Garfield Avenue, Suite 206
  • Request: This is a request for a Planned Development Permit,
  Conditional Use Permit, and Variance to establish a tutoring center
  (Young Crops Education Center) in an existing 1,150 square foot unit
  3
  09/19/2022
   of an office building with less than the required number of parking
  spaces in the PO (Professional Office) zone. (This application is
  exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act.)
  •  Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution 22-27 approving Planned
  Development Permit PD-21-32, Conditional Use Permit CUP-20-09
  and Variance VAR-21-12 subject to the Conditions of approval.
  •  Principal Planner Paul Lam provided the Staff presentation.
  •  Luyu Li, the Applicant, was available to answer questions.
  •  The public hearing was opened and then closed.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to adopt Resolution No. 22-27 approving Planned Development
  Permit PD-21-32, Conditional Use Permit CUP-20-09 and Variance
  VAR-21-12 with an amendment to Condition of Approval PL4 to reflect:
  “The Applicant shall make every effort to ensure that their clients do not
  engage in any trespassing of the neighboring properties, littering, or
  blocking of the neighbor’s properties that prevent the neighbors from
  accessing their off-street parking spaces.”
  •  Moved by Commissioner Sahu, Seconded by Commissioner Wang.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 10-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Ho, Juarez, Mojarro, Olson, Pham, Sahu, Tsujii, Wang,
  Garcia, Gardea
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

MOTION:

  Garcia, Gardea

G.  DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 1:  PRESENTATION SERIES ON THE COMPREHENSIVE ZONING CODE
  UPDATE (8:20 P.M.)
  • This is the continuation of the second presentation in a series of
  presentations on the Comprehensive Zoning Code Update project
  presented by the Planning Division staff.
  • Recommended Action: It is recommended that the Planning
  Commission receive and file this informational report and provide
  input to Staff as deemed appropriate.
  • Principal Planner Paul Lam provided the Staff presentation.
  • Public Comments:
  1.) Lewis McCammon
  2.) Jennifer Ng
  3.) Michael McCollum
